priorityList: Summon Infernal on cooldown for major damage and resource generation.
Cast Malevolence during Summon Infernal or when facing high-priority AoE windows.
Cast Rain of Fire as your primary Soul Shard spender when facing 4 or more enemies.
Cast Ruination immediately whenever it becomes available.
Cast Cataclysm to apply and spread Wither to all targets in the pack.
Use Shadowburn if Malevolence is active, Fiendish Cruelty is procced, or the target is below 20% health.
Apply Havoc to a high-health secondary target when facing 2-3 enemies to cleave your spells.
Cast Chaos Bolt as your Soul Shard spender if there are 3 or fewer enemies.
Cast Soul Fire if you have fewer than 4 Soul Shards and the target is not about to die.
Maintain Wither on all targets; manually refresh it if Cataclysm is on cooldown and the target will survive at least 8 seconds.
Cast Conflagrate if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Backdraft to generate shards and speed up casts.
Use Channel Demonfire on cooldown if the primary target is afflicted by Wither or Immolate.
Cast Incinerate as your filler to generate Soul Shards when no other priority actions are available.
